name: Dien Bien Phu
provinceNote: Điện Biên province stayed in place. Resolution 202/2025/QH15 left it unchanged, and the statistics office catalog reads “Giữ nguyên, không sắp xếp” for the province. Resolution 1661/NQ-UBTVQH15 of 16 June 2025, in force 1 July 2025, merged the old wards Him Lam, Tân Thanh, Mường Thanh, Thanh Bình, and Thanh Trường and the old xã Thanh Minh into phường Điện Biên Phủ, and merged xã Nà Nhạn, Pá Khoang, and Mường Phăng into xã Mường Phăng. The provincial capital is also written Thành phố Điện Biên Phủ. The museum and the relic board use phường Điện Biên Phủ, tỉnh Điện Biên.
dotReason: The 1954 basin is the reason to stop, on the far side of Pha Đin.
summary: A valley city in the far northwest, site of the famous 1954 battle, ringed by hills and rice fields. Climb Hill D1 to the victory monument, walk the battle hills and the Muong Thanh bridge, and try local dishes such as pa pinh top, folded grilled fish. One night suits history travellers.
timeNeeded: One night, or two if Mường Phăng is next

seoTitle: Dien Bien Phu travel guide — the 1954 battle, A1 Hill, the bunker and museum
seoDescription: The 1954 battle in the Mường Thanh basin: the monument on Đồi D1, A1 Hill, the De Castries bunker, and the museum. Sơn La is the other side of Pha Đin.
intro: You stand in the Mường Thanh basin, where the 1954 battle was fought, rice on the valley floor and the victory monument on Đồi D1. From the hill you see the city, the yellow rice, and the ridges. Stay if that monument and this basin are the trip. Sleep in Sơn La if the night you wanted is the prison hill on the other side of Pha Đin. Sleep in Mộc Châu if you wanted the tea morning further east. This city is the basin after the pass. It is not the pass.

The bed is a small hotel or guesthouse in phường Điện Biên Phủ, near the monument and the Nậm Rốm. From 1 July 2025 that ward includes the old wards Him Lam, Tân Thanh, Mường Thanh, Thanh Bình, and Thanh Trường and the old xã Thanh Minh. No hotel brand is a pick. After dark the address is Phố đi bộ Mường Thanh, beside the Nậm Rốm, in the block called Khu đô thị mới – Chợ Du lịch Mường Thanh. The monument yard holds a cultural program on Saturday evenings and on holidays. Đồi A1 has a separate night opening. On 23 March 2026 later evenings on the walking street were thin: a few drink stalls at the head of the street, most booths not yet trading. Do not expect a full night market every evening, and do not treat this street as the 2012 night market on Nguyễn Chí Thanh.

Give the morning to the monument, then A1 Hill, the De Castries bunker, and the Mường Thanh bridge, and leave the museum on its own ticket. The relic gates open at 7:00. They shut from 11:00 to 13:30, then open again until 18:00 in the spring-summer block or 17:30 in the autumn-winter block. Arriving at noon wastes the hills. Mường Phăng is the next morning, not a second city. The mistake is booking Sơn La or Mộc Châu when the monument is the reason you stopped, or paying the relic’s 20,000 VND point ticket and assuming it covers the museum.
gettingAround: The nearest airport is Cảng hàng không Điện Biên, IATA DIN. It is also called Cảng hàng không quốc tế Điện Biên, Cảng hàng không Điện Biên Phủ, and sân bay Mường Thanh, in the old phường Thanh Trường, inside phường Điện Biên Phủ from 1 July 2025. There is no rail station in the city.

By road from Hanoi you take National Highway 279, then National Highway 6, over Pha Đin. Pha Đin is the pass on the Sơn La road. It is not this city. Bến xe Mỹ Đình lists Chi nhánh Hà Nội – Công ty TNHH HVĐB to Điện Biên Phủ at 19:30, 20:15, 20:45, and 21:15.

The monument, the museum, A1, the bunker, and the bridge sit in the basin ward. Him Lam is on đường Võ Nguyên Giáp, the old road 41, toward Tuần Giáo. Mường Phăng is the forest headquarters the next morning. The cannon-pull road at old xã Nà Nhạn is beside Highway 279. That commune is inside xã Mường Phăng from 1 July 2025.

National Highway 279 inside the province runs from Tuần Giáo through the city to the Tây Trang border gate. National Highway 12 runs from the city to the Ma Lu Thàng border gate. Tuần Giáo is the district town on the pass road. Thick fog sits on Pha Đin in December–February. June–August rain is the stretch to avoid. Relic day hours change on 1 March and 1 October.

stayAreas.name: Basin ward
stayAreas.summary: Small hotels and guesthouses in phường Điện Biên Phủ, near the victory monument and the Nậm Rốm. From 1 July 2025 the ward includes the old wards Him Lam, Tân Thanh, Mường Thanh, Thanh Bình, and Thanh Trường and the old xã Thanh Minh. No hotel brand is a pick.

eat: The nine named plates are pa pỉnh tộp, cáy pỉnh, xôi nếp nương, steamed black chicken, ban flower, bitter bamboo, pork in leaves, bon soup, and hearth-dried meat. Bản Phiêng Lơi is the hamlet table at the city entrance.

Also on the table: kitchen-smoked buffalo, duck with banana flower, cabbage-wrapped oleaster, and chẩm chéo, plus sâu chít, gạo tám, and bánh dày. Bamboo worms, Mông wine, mountain goat, and Đà River fish are named without a method.
interestsBody: The night is the basin under the monument. A1 Hill, the De Castries bunker, the museum, the Nậm Rốm, and the forest headquarters at Mường Phăng split the day. Sơn La is the valley on the other side of Pha Đin. Mộc Châu is the tea plateau further east.

Pa pỉnh tộp is folded grilled fish: a fish of 1–1.5 kg, opened along the back, salted, and stuffed with mắc khén, roasted fresh chili, spring onion, herbs, and coriander, then clamped with bamboo. Chẩm chéo is named as a sauce beside the fish. Cáy pỉnh is chicken grilled after local herbs, wrapped in lemongrass leaves, skin crisp, the meat smelling of mắc khén, with a cup of rice wine. Xôi nếp nương is upland sticky rice steamed twice, colored red, purple, yellow, and green. A ball of it leaves the hand clean. The packet is not cơm lam. Gà đen hấp is steamed black chicken from Tủa Chùa. Nộm rau ban is young ban flower and leaves, in March when the flower is on the passes. Măng đắng is forest bamboo with a sweet-bitter taste. Nhứa phò is minced pork shoulder wrapped in leaves and grilled until the leaf is dry at the edge and the meat is yellow. Canh bon is a Thái soup of buffalo or beef skin, sweet dọc bon, wild eggplant, herbs, mắc khén, and lemongrass. Nhứa giảng is meat dried over a wood fire, usually buffalo, pork, and beef, still red and hot. Kitchen-smoked buffalo is also named, without a statement that it is the same cut. No restaurant is a pick.

body: Đồi D1 is the eastern outpost of the Dominique group. The copper monument stands there so the view takes in the city, the yellow rice, and the ridges. The group is three soldiers and one Thái child. The flag reads “Quyết chiến, quyết thắng.” The sculptor is Nguyễn Hải. The ceremony yard is about 3,000 m², used for cultural programs on Saturday evenings and on holidays. The group weighs 217 tons. The yard size and the weight are two measurements. The hill is also called a peace park with a view over the city. Mường Thanh is the largest basin in the Northwest.

The victory museum is a separate ticket. From age 18 the visit is 100,000 VND, and 5,000 VND is also given for one of five sites at the museum. The building opened in 1984 for the 30th anniversary, was reworked at the end of 2003, and then had five galleries, 274 objects, and 122 paintings. Standing hours are summer 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–18:00, and winter 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:30. From 13 July 2026 the hours are 7:30–12:00 and 13:30–21:00. Also 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00.

body: Đồi A1 watches the basin. The French name is Eliane 2. The local names are Pú Lạng Chượng and Đồi Đồn Tây. The fighting lasted 39 days and nights and more than 2,500 soldiers died. On the crest are a tank of 18 tons, the French bunker, the trench system, and a blast crater of 960 kg, restored in 2004 for the 50th anniversary. Day hours shut from 11:00 to 13:30. A1 also opens at night, 19:30–21:30 on Friday, Saturday, and official holidays. The lighting was finished in December 2024 and the night opening started 1 January 2025.

The De Castries bunker is the heart of the French command. The flag went on the roof at 17:30 on 7 May 1954. The 15:00 order on 7 May is the assault order at the forest headquarters, not this flag minute. From this stop you can also see the Mường Thanh bridge, burned-out tanks left in place, and French 105 mm and 155 mm gun positions. Those guns are not separate stops. The bunker is one of the four electronic-receipt points, at 20,000 VND if it is charged as its own point. The bridge the French called Bailey crosses the Nậm Rốm, 40 m long and 5 m wide. Soldiers crossed it on the afternoon of 7 May 1954.

Him Lam, Béatrice, is the outer strongpoint on the old road 41, now đường Võ Nguyên Giáp, the northeast gate toward Tuần Giáo. The assault started at 17:00 on 13 March 1954 and the position fell at 23:30 the same day. Phan Đình Giót is named there. The phase-two conservation project was inaugurated on 9 March 2026. The 13 March date is the 1954 battle, not a festival calendar. Him Lam is not in the four-point list.

Hill E is the veterans’ center on the eastern Dominique hills, built for the 50th anniversary in 2004 as a Thái stilt-house gallery with 106 gifts. People come to offer incense for Hồ Chí Minh and the dead. Hill F, Mont Fictif, is immediately east of A1. The memorial was started on 13 March 2021 on 4.95 ha, with a wooden temple, a still court, and a pool, then expected to open in 2022, and also expected on 7 May 2022. On 4 May 2026 Đồi F and the memorial were among the points receiving visitors. The 4 May 2026 list is a holiday staffing plan, not a new clock. The special national relic has 45 component points. Độc Lập is in that catalog at xã Thanh Nưa, huyện Điện Biên, with no kilometre. It is not a stop from the basin.

Mường Phăng is the forest command used from 31 January 1954 to 15 May 1954. More than 20 huts and shelters have been rebuilt, including Võ Nguyên Giáp’s hut and the tunnel through the hill. The tunnel is 69 m and the forest area about 90 km². The general attack order went out at 15:00 on 7 May 1954. The parade ground at Phiêng Tá Lét, on 13 May 1954, has a later monument of 25 figures and six flags. Use 40 km by road from the city center, about 10 km from Highway 6, and 17 km only as the straight line. From 1 July 2025, xã Mường Phăng is the merged commune of Nà Nhạn, Pá Khoang, and Mường Phăng, not a ward of the basin. The lookout on Pú Tó Cọ is 1,700 m, and the visit there is a footpath of more than 4 km from bản Khá, not a drive to the hut. The headquarters is one of the four receipt points, at the relic’s 20,000 VND point rate. Hồ Pá Khoang is the lake near Mường Phăng, with cherry blossom in spring and Thái houses beside the relic. The cannon-pull road at Nà Nhạn is the short stop about 14 km toward Mường Phăng. Tô Vĩnh Diện is named there. Do not confuse that 14 km stop with Pha Đin.

blocks.heading: Central Market I
paragraphs: Chợ Trung tâm I is the city’s wholesale market, in the old phường Tân Thanh, now inside phường Điện Biên Phủ. It opened in 1992 with about 150 kiosks.

blocks.heading: Muong Thanh walking street
paragraphs: Phố đi bộ Mường Thanh, beside the Nậm Rốm, opened on the evening of 7 March 2026 during Ban flower week. The plan is local goods, OCOP, and highland cloth. Most booths were not yet trading on 23 March 2026. Weekday trade has been given as afternoon and evening, and the weekend as running through the day. The Saturday yard under the monument is about 3,000 m² and holds cultural programs on Saturday evenings and on holidays. Him Lam Plaza, in the old phường Tân Thanh, is one of two rank-III trade centers in the province.

blocks.heading: Nguyen Chi Thanh night market
paragraphs: A 2012 night market on Nguyễn Chí Thanh ran from the Trần Đăng Ninh junction to the provincial youth-house crossing, 580 m, about 4,500 m², nearly 90 temporary stalls and more than 160 households, open daily 20:00–23:30. It is a different street from Phố đi bộ Mường Thanh. Ask locally whether it still opens.

faqs.q: How do I get from Hanoi to Dien Bien Phu?
faqs.a: By air, about 1 hour 15 minutes and 539 km, with 2 flights a day, and also about 1 hour 5 minutes and 453 km, with about 1–2 flights a day, and also about one hour. By road, 478 km via Highway 279 then Highway 6, and also about 400 km and about 10 hours, and 453 km and 15 hours. Fares move. There is no rail station in the city.

faqs.q: How far is Pha Din from Dien Bien Phu and from Son La?
faqs.a: The pass is 32 km, and a post-2005 alignment is 26 km, at more than 1,000 m, with a summit also given as 1,648 m. From this city nearly 100 km and about 84 km to the end of the pass, and 80 km to the summit, in 2–2.5 hours. From Sơn La, 66 km to the start, and also 65 km. These pairs are not one total. A separate figure is 160 km and 10 hours between the two cities.

faqs.q: What does the victory museum cost, and when is it open?
faqs.a: 100,000 VND a visit from age 18, and also 5,000 VND a person for one of five sites at the museum. Standing hours are summer 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–18:00, and winter 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:30. From 13 July 2026 the hours are 7:30–12:00 and 13:30–21:00. Also 7:00–11:00 and 13:30–17:00. The relic’s 20,000 VND point ticket does not cover this museum.

faqs.q: Is 7 May still free for ethnic residents of the province?
faqs.a: In 2018, fees were waived for ethnic residents of the province on Tết (3 days), 2 September, 30 April, 1 May, and 7 May, at seven named sites, until the council amended an older resolution. The current relic fee does not repeat that waiver. The 17:30 flag on the De Castries bunker and the 15:00 order at Mường Phăng are two moments on 7 May 1954, not two festival clocks.

season.label: Ban flower in March
season.note: Ban flower week is yearly, in the middle of March, tied to the opening of the attack on 13 March 1954. In 2026 the province first planned 20–26 March, then moved the week to 6–12 March when the blossom moved, with the opening at 20:10 on Sunday 8 March 2026 at the provincial stadium in phường Điện Biên Phủ. The main events sit in that ward. Thick fog sits on Pha Đin in December–February. June–August rain is the stretch to avoid on the pass. The summit is also given as 14–22°C. Relic day hours change on 1 March and 1 October: spring-summer runs to 18:00, autumn-winter to 17:30, and the gates shut from 11:00 to 13:30.
